钻石行业通过声誉债券和私人仲裁系统来执行合同。交易中的声誉债券价值相当于违约方未来可能损失的交易利润。此外，还存在两种社会债券：具有市场价值的“主要社会债券”，其损失会削弱交易商获取信息和商业机会的能力；以及价值更偏向个人层面、经济影响较小的“次要社会债券”。声誉债券是确保仲裁裁决得以遵守的根本原因。

交易俱乐部（交易所）的私人仲裁系统是核心机制，其一个重要特点是保密性：只要裁决得到遵守，仲裁的事实和结果都将对外保密。仲裁员被要求在听证会后十天内作出裁决。裁决的执行力极强，若有成员在10个工作日内不遵守裁决，其照片将被张贴在俱乐部内，并通报给世界钻石交易所联盟（WFDB）的所有成员。该联盟要求各成员交易所相互执行仲裁裁决，从而形成一个跨境执行网络。仲裁委员会有权暂停或开除不支付裁决的成员，通过行业排斥的威胁来确保合规。
source: The typical diamond transaction involves the posting of a reputation bond equal to the present value of the profit on future transactions that will not take place if the promisor breaches a contract, less his ability to cover.

There are two types of social bonds. Primary social bonds are similar to reputation bonds in that they have a market value. When a primary social bond is sacrificed, a dealer's ability to communicate information about his reputation and obtain information about business opportunities is diminished. In contrast, secondary social bonds may have a value to the individual on a personal level, but their loss often will not have a direct economic effect on the promisor.
Reputation bonds, however, are the primary reason that the arbitration tribunal's decisions are obeyed; they are essential to the bourse's ability to enforce its judgments.

An important feature of the arbitration system is the secrecy of the proceedings. The arbitrators are not required to make findings of fact and do not produce written decisions explaining their reasoning. As long as judgments are complied with, the fact of the arbitration as well as its outcome are officially kept secret.
Arbitrators are required to render their decision within ten days of the hearing.

The DDC Bylaws provide that "[a]ll decisions of arbitration panels including floor committee arbitrations which are not complied with within 10 working days, together with the picture of the non-complying member, shall be posted in a conspicuous place in the Club rooms.
This information is communicated to all bourses in the world federation. As a condition of membership in the federation, each bourse agrees to enforce the judgments of all member bourses.

The arbitration board can also suspend or expel a member for failing to pay a judgment or failing to pay his diamond-related creditors without making special arrangements through the club's private bankruptcy system.

qa_pairs.question: 比较法律合同与非法律合同的成本效益，指出法院==预期损害赔偿计算==的不确定性、==诉讼周期长==（纽约法院可能长达3年）以及==声誉损害风险==等缺陷。论证钻石行业私人治理系统如何通过==快速纠纷解决==、==灵活损害赔偿裁定==（包括惩罚性赔偿）和==维护交易秘密==实现帕累托最优，支持该系统比传统法律制度更具效率优势的核心假设。 Compares the cost-effectiveness of legal versus extralegal contracts, identifying deficiencies such as uncertainty in court ==expectation damages calculation==, ==lengthy litigation cycles== (up to 3 years in New York courts), and ==reputational damage risks==. Argues how the diamond industry's private governance system achieves Pareto superiority through ==rapid dispute resolution==, ==flexible damage awards== (including punitive damages), and ==maintaining transaction secrecy==, supporting the core hypothesis that this system offers efficiency advantages over traditional legal regimes. 分析维度3：法律体系缺陷与私人治理的效率优势 Analysis Dimension 3: Legal System Deficiencies and Efficiency Advantages of Private Governance请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 该论文论证，钻石行业的私人治理体系之所以优于传统法律体系，是因为后者存在诸多缺陷。首先，法院在计算预期损害赔偿时存在不确定性，尤其难以量化利润损失，且诉讼周期漫长（纽约法院可达三年），导致当事人蒙受无法弥补的损失。其次，诉讼会公开交易细节，损害行业高度重视的“保密”声誉。相比之下，钻石行业的私人仲裁系统通过快速纠纷解决和强制执行，实现了帕累托最优。该系统允许仲裁员裁定包括惩罚性赔偿在内的任何适当损害赔偿，从而更有效地补偿受害方并威慑违约行为。此外，只要判决得到遵守，仲裁过程和结果都将保密，从而维护了交易者的声誉和持续经营能力。这些优势共同支持了该私人治理体系比公共法律体系更有效率的核心假设。
source: The sources of this inefficiency are the uncertainty of recovery, the way courts calculate damages, the length of time it takes to obtain a judgment, and, in some instances, the fact that many diamantaires do not have ready access to capital markets.

The longer it takes to obtain a judgment, which in New York court can take up to three years, the greater will be the uncompensated loss suffered by the promissee when his ability to enter into subsequent transactions is impaired due to lack of capital.
Secrecy is highly valued, and whoever makes public the workings of the business will suffer a loss in the value of his reputation, even if he is merely defending himself against a meritless lawsuit.
The private regime must be Pareto superior to the established legal regime in order to survive.
the system's overall success is due, in large part, to its ability to quickly resolve disputes and enforce judgments-results that cannot be obtained through the legal system.

Unlike courts, whose award of damages is limited by either expectation damages or a valid liquidated damages clause, the DDC bylaws allow arbitrators to award any measure of damages they think is appropriate, including punitive damages.

An important feature of the arbitration system is the secrecy of the proceedings. The arbitrators are not required to make findings of fact and do not produce written decisions explaining their reasoning. As long as judgments are complied with, the fact of the arbitration as well as its outcome are officially kept secret.

qa_pairs.question: 钻石行业通过**声誉债券**、**交易俱乐部仲裁系统**和**保密规范**构建的==私人治理体系==，在解决合同纠纷方面比国家法律体系更具效率，能够实现快速争议解决、维护行业机密并降低交易成本。 The diamond industry has constructed a ==private governance system== through **reputation bonds**, **bourse arbitration systems**, and **secrecy norms**, which is more efficient than the state legal system in resolving contractual disputes, enabling rapid dispute resolution, maintaining industry confidentiality, and reducing transaction costs.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 钻石行业确实建立了一套私人治理体系，该体系系统性地排斥国家法律，代之以一套内部规则、机构和制裁措施。该体系的核心是声誉债券、交易俱乐部（Bourse）的仲裁系统以及保密规范。行业组织通过促进强大的声誉债券来支持仲裁系统执行其判决。仲裁具有程序和实体上的优势，能够快速、低成本且秘密地解决争议和执行判决，从而控制声誉损害并减少违约方的实际损失。例如，仲裁员被要求在听证会后十天内做出裁决，并且只要判决得到遵守，仲裁的事实和结果都会被官方保密。这套规则和制度被行业参与者认为明显优于法律体系，因为它能够实现快速争议解决和判决执行，而这些是法律体系无法提供的结果。
source: The diamond industry has systematically rejected state-created law. In its place, the sophisticated traders who dominate the industry have developed an elaborate, internal set of rules, complete with distinctive institutions and sanctions, to handle disputes among industry members.
Sections IVD and E focus on the ways the industry's organization facilitates the creation of strong reputational bonds, which the bourse's arbitration system in turn uses to enforce its judgments.

In the diamond industry, arbitration has important substantive and procedural advantages over adjudication. It enables parties to resolve disputes and enforce judgments quickly, inexpensively, and secretly, thereby containing damage to reputation and reducing the actual damage suffered by the promisee in event of breach.
Arbitrators are required to render their decision within ten days of the hearing.

An important feature of the arbitration system is the secrecy of the proceedings. The arbitrators are not required to make findings of fact and do not produce written decisions explaining their reasoning. As long as judgments are complied with, the fact of the arbitration as well as its outcome are officially kept secret.
the system's overall success is due, in large part, to its ability to quickly resolve disputes and enforce judgments-results that cannot be obtained through the legal system.

By a variety of reputational bonds, customary business practices, and arbitration proceedings, the diamond industry has developed a set of rules and institutions that its participants find clearly superior to the legal system.

qa_pairs.question: 法律体系的结构性缺陷促使行业自建治理机制 Structural Deficiencies in the Legal System Prompt Industry to Establish Self-Governance Mechanisms 美国法律体系在计算**期待损害赔偿**时存在不确定性，司法程序耗时长达三年，且无法充分补偿钻石交易中特有的**声誉损失**和**商业机会丧失**，导致行业普遍认为通过诉讼解决纠纷会造成==低效违约==和不可挽回的经济损失。 The American legal system has uncertainties in calculating **expectation damages**, judicial proceedings take up to three years, and cannot fully compensate for **reputational losses** and **lost business opportunities** unique to diamond transactions, leading the industry to generally believe that resolving disputes through litigation would result in ==inefficient breach== and irreparable economic harm.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 论文指出，如果钻石行业的商业交易完全依赖于可依法强制执行的合同，并以期待损害赔偿作为违约救济，市场将会频繁出现低效违约。这种低效源于几个结构性缺陷：赔偿的不确定性、法院计算损害赔償的方式、获得判决所需的时间（在纽约法院可能长达三年），以及许多钻石商无法轻易获得资本。具体而言，法院难以计算因交易失败而损失的利润，因为利润具有高度的特异性。同样，因对方未付款而错失的商业机会价值被认为是投机性的，法院无法准确估量。此外，当一方的违约导致另一方对第三方违约时，受害方会遭受长期的声誉损害，而这种损失在标准的损害赔偿措施下无法得到补偿。
source: If commercial transactions in the industry were governed solely by explicit, legally enforceable contracts under which the promisee could recover expectation damages in the event of breach, the market would be characterized by frequent inefficient breach of contract.

The sources of this inefficiency are the uncertainty of recovery, the way courts calculate damages, the length of time it takes to obtain a judgment, and, in some instances, the fact that many diamantaires do not have ready access to capital markets.
In a diamond transaction, when a seller fails to deliver a stone, lost profit is extraordinarily difficult to calculate since it is highly idiosyncratic.

Similarly, when a buyer breaches a promise to pay money, it is difficult, if not impossible, to determine the profit the promisee would have made subsequent to the breach had he been able to invest the money he was owed-the value of business opportunities forgone is inherently speculative.

The longer it takes to obtain a judgment, which in New York court can take up to three years, the greater will be the uncompensated loss suffered by the promissee when his ability to enter into subsequent transactions is impaired due to lack of capital.

In addition, when the promisor's default causes the promisee to breach other contracts, the promisee will suffer long-term damage to his reputation for which he will not be compensated under standard damage measures.

qa_pairs.question: 声誉机制与私人仲裁的协同效应保障合同履行 Synergistic Effect of Reputational Mechanisms and Private Arbitration Ensures Contract Performance 钻石行业通过**交易俱乐部**（如纽约钻石经销商俱乐部）的仲裁系统，结合==声誉债券==（违约者将被全球钻石交易所公示并驱逐），形成了比法律制裁更有效的履约激励；仲裁裁决平均10天内作出，且保持**保密性**，最大限度减少了纠纷对商业关系的损害。 Through the arbitration system of **trading clubs** (such as the New York Diamond Dealers Club) combined with ==reputation bonds== (defaulters are publicly notified and expelled from global diamond bourses), the diamond industry has formed a more effective performance incentive than legal sanctions; arbitration awards are rendered within an average of 10 days and maintain **confidentiality**, minimizing the damage of disputes to business relationships.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 钻石行业的私人治理体系通过其仲裁程序与强大的声誉机制之间的协同作用，有效保障了合同的履行。声誉债券是仲裁裁决得以遵守的首要原因，对交易所强制执行其判决的能力至关重要。如果成员未能在十个工作日内遵守仲裁裁决，其照片将被张贴在俱乐部房间，并且此信息会通报给世界钻石交易所联合会的所有成员交易所，这些交易所必须执行成员交易所的判决。仲裁委员会还可以暂停或开除不遵守裁决的成员。该系统旨在快速响应，要求仲裁员在听证会后十天内作出裁决。其一个关键特点是保密性；只要判决得到及时支付，争议及其结果都将保密，这为遵守裁决以避免公开造成的声誉损害提供了强大动力。
source: Reputation bonds, however, are the primary reason that the arbitration tribunal's decisions are obeyed; they are essential to the bourse's ability to enforce its judgments.

The DDC Bylaws provide that "[a]ll decisions of arbitration panels including floor committee arbitrations which are not complied with within 10 working days, together with the picture of the non-complying member, shall be posted in a conspicuous place in the Club rooms.
This information is communicated to all bourses in the world federation. As a condition of membership in the federation, each bourse agrees to enforce the judgments of all member bourses.

The arbitration board can also suspend or expel a member for failing to pay a judgment or failing to pay his diamond-related creditors without making special arrangements through the club's private bankruptcy system.
Arbitrators are required to render their decision within ten days of the hearing.

An important feature of the arbitration system is the secrecy of the proceedings. As long as judgments are complied with, the fact of the arbitration as well as its outcome are officially kept secret.
Thus, the threat of publicity and the practice of keeping disputes secret as long as judgments are paid gives the defendant an incentive to promptly comply with the arbitrators' judgment.

qa_pairs.question: 钻石行业的特殊性质，包括钻石估值的主观性、交易的保密性需求、对即时信用的高度依赖，以及现有法律体系在损害赔偿计算、程序效率和保密性方面的不足，使得市场参与者需要一种替代的合同执行机制。 The special nature of the diamond industry, including the subjectivity of diamond valuation, the need for transaction secrecy, the high reliance on immediate credit, and the shortcomings of the existing legal system in terms of damage calculation, procedural efficiency, and confidentiality, necessitates an alternative contract enforcement mechanism for market participants.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 钻石行业具有独特的性质，包括估值的主观性、对交易保密性的高度重视、以及对信贷的巨大需求，这使得其交易市场也扮演着隐性资本市场的角色。如果完全依赖法律体系，由于其在损害赔偿计算、诉讼耗时以及交易者缺乏现成资本等方面的缺陷，将导致频繁且低效的违约。具体而言，法院在实践中不愿意赔偿被视为“投机性”的损失利润，而这在钻石交易中尤其难以计算。此外，在纽约法院获得判决可能需要长达三年，这期间资本被占用会给承诺方带来无法得到完全补偿的巨大损失。最后，由于行业高度重视保密性，交易者担心诉讼会暴露商业实践，因此更倾向于在交易所的仲裁庭解决纠纷，因为在那里，只要判决得到遵守，争议的存在和结果都会被保密。
source: Diamond valuation is a subjective process.
In the diamond industry, where profitability depends largely on a dealer's network of contacts, secrecy is valued; large-scale transactions tend to be consummated in private offices.
There is a great need for credit in the diamond industry.
The market for rough and polished diamonds functions not only as a commodities market but also as an implicit capital market.

If commercial transactions in the industry were governed solely by explicit, legally enforceable contracts under which the promisee could recover expectation damages in the event of breach, the market would be characterized by frequent inefficient breach of contract.

The sources of this inefficiency are the uncertainty of recovery, the way courts calculate damages, the length of time it takes to obtain a judgment, and, in some instances, the fact that many diamantaires do not have ready access to capital markets.

In practice, courts are reluctant to award compensation for lost profit since in most instances it is considered speculative. In a diamond transaction, when a seller fails to deliver a stone, lost profit is extraordinarily difficult to calculate since it is highly idiosyncratic.

The longer it takes to obtain a judgment, which in New York court can take up to three years, the greater will be the uncompensated loss suffered by the promissee when his ability to enter into subsequent transactions is impaired due to lack of capital.

Secrecy is highly valued, and whoever makes public the workings of the business will suffer a loss in the value of his reputation, even if he is merely defending himself against a meritless lawsuit. Consequently, individual traders, fearful of litigation that might reveal trade practices, prefer to conclude transactions using agreements that are enforceable only in the bourse's arbitration tribunals, where the existence and outcome of a dispute are kept secret as long as the judgment is paid promptly.

qa_pairs.question: 步骤1：建立交易俱乐部（交易所）作为核心组织平台 Step 1: Establish trading clubs (bourses) as core organizational platforms 1 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 论文指出，交易俱乐部（即“交易所”或“bourse”）是钻石行业的核心组织平台和全球分销网络中的“关键环节”。例如，美国最大且最重要的交易俱乐部是纽约钻石交易俱乐部（DDC）。这些俱乐部不仅是商品交易所，同样也是信息交易所，其核心功能之一是促进关于交易商声誉信息的传播，并对会员起到声誉信号和监督的作用。俱乐部及其仲裁体系的主要功能是增强支撑着整个行业法外契约制度的声誉纽带。作为会员资格的条件，交易商必须同意将所有商业纠纷提交给俱乐部的私人仲裁系统，这进一步巩固了交易所作为行业自治核心机构的地位。
source: The largest and most important trading club ('bourse') in the United States is the New York Diamond Dealers Club.
...a dealer who does not have access to the trading clubs-essential links in the worldwide diamond distribution network-will be at a competitive disadvantage.
The bourse is an information exchange as much as it is a commodities exchange.
The bourse facilitates the transmission of information about dealers' reputations and, at least with respect to members, serves both a reputation-signaling and a reputation-monitoring function.
The main function of both the club and its arbitration system is to enhance the functioning of reputation bonds.
As a condition of membership, a dealer must sign an agreement to submit all disputes arising from the diamond business between himself and another member to the club's arbitration system.

qa_pairs.question: - 设定会员资格标准，包括行业经验、财务责任和道德声誉要求 - Set membership criteria, including industry experience, financial responsibility, and ethical reputation requirements 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 与提问的说法相反，论文指出钻石商俱乐部确实设定了严格的会员资格标准。具体而言，申请人必须在行业内有至少两年的从业经验。此外，俱乐部通过一个声誉审查程序来评估道德声誉：新成员的申请照片会被公示十天，以便现有成员有机会提出不应接纳其入会的理由。尽管没有明确列出财务责任作为新会员的直接标准，但其重要性体现在一项规定中，即担保会员需为他们介绍的非本地交易商的“行为和责任”承担“全部财务责任”。
source: To be considered for membership a dealer must (1) have been in the industry for at least two years, (2) comply with all requests for information put to him by the board of directors, and (3) have his picture posted in the club for ten days so that members have the opportunity to state reasons that he should not be accepted.

Before being admitted to the trading hall, out-of-town dealers must be introduced by a member in good standing who agrees to assume “full financial responsibility (guarantee) for the out of town dealer’s acts and liabilities, incurred while on the premises of the DDC.”

As stated in its bylaws, the purposes of the club are, among other things, “to inculcate just and equitable principles in trade, to eliminate abuses and unfair trade practices relative thereto or affecting the same, to diffuse accurate and reliable information concerning the matters relating thereto, [and] to produce uniformity in the conduct of business ethics.”

qa_pairs.question: - 要求会员签署仲裁协议，承诺将所有行业纠纷提交内部仲裁而非法院诉讼 - Require members to sign arbitration agreements, committing to submit all industry disputes to internal arbitration rather than court litigation 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文内容，该陈述是正确的。作为成为钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）会员的条件，交易商必须签署一份具有约束力的协议，承诺将所有因钻石业务而产生的、与其他会员之间的纠纷提交给俱乐部的仲裁系统。除非俱乐部选择不审理案件，否则会员不得在法庭上寻求救济。如果会员试图诉诸法庭，他们将面临罚款或被俱乐部开除的惩罚，而且由于仲裁协议具有约束力，法院也不会受理此案。
source: As a condition of membership, a dealer must sign an agreement to submit all disputes arising from the diamond business between himself and another member to the club's arbitration system.
The agreement to arbitrate is binding.
Unless the club opts not to hear the case, the member may not seek redress of his grievances in court.
If he does so, he will be fined or expelled from the club.
Furthermore, since the agreement to arbitrate is binding, the court will not hear the case.

qa_pairs.question: 步骤2：发展基于声誉的合同执行机制 Step 2: Develop reputation-based contract enforcement mechanisms 1 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: The diamond industry has already developed a sophisticated system of rules and institutions for contract enforcement that is based on reputational bonds, customary practices, and arbitration, which participants find superior to the legal system. Reputation bonds are the primary mechanism ensuring that arbitration decisions are obeyed and are essential to the bourse's ability to enforce its judgments. Ultimately, discipline in the diamond trade is maintained primarily by the fear of damage to one's reputation, rather than by the formal arbitration system or the courts.
source: By a variety of reputational bonds, customary business practices, and arbitration proceedings, the diamond industry has developed a set of rules and institutions that its participants find clearly superior to the legal system.
Reputation bonds, however, are the primary reason that the arbitration tribunal's decisions are obeyed; they are essential to the bourse's ability to enforce its judgments.

Thus, it appears that the dispute resolution institutions in the diamond industry can fairly be called extralegal: it is primarily the fear of damage to reputation that maintains discipline in the diamond trade, not the bourse's board of arbitrators or the procedural right to appeal arbitrated decisions in court.

qa_pairs.question: - 利用行业内信息快速传播网络（如交易所内部 grapevine），形成对违约行为的声誉惩罚机制 - Utilize intra-industry rapid information dissemination networks (such as the bourse grapevine) to form reputation penalty mechanisms for breach of contract 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据该论文，这一说法是正确的。钻石行业的交易俱乐部（bourses）是高效的信息交换中心，其“交易所内部传闻（bourse grapevine）”被描述为能像卫星通信网络一样高效地在全球范围内传播信息。这个网络是声誉惩罚机制的核心，用于执行仲裁裁决。如果成员未能在规定时间内遵守裁决，其照片和违约信息将在俱乐部内显眼位置张贴，并通报给世界钻石交易所联盟的所有成员。这种公开曝光的威胁是一种强大的压力，能够“几乎瞬间”让违约交易商破产。因此，整个市场通过促进声誉信息的快速、低成本传播，建立了一套有效的私人制裁体系，以威慑违约行为。
source: As one author put it, “the bourse grapevine is the best in the world. It has been going for years and moves with the efficiency of a satellite communications network. . . . Bourses are the fountainhead of this information and from them it is passed out along the tentacles that stretch around the world.”

The DDC Bylaws provide that "[a]ll decisions of arbitration panels including floor committee arbitrations which are not complied with within 10 working days, together with the picture of the non-complying member, shall be posted in a conspicuous place in the Club rooms.
This information is communicated to all bourses in the world federation.

Unlike a court, the DDC has the ability to bring unique pressures on the losing party to pay: it can put him out of business almost instantaneously by hanging his picture in the clubroom of every bourse in the world with a notice that he failed to pay his debt.

The market is organized to promote the low cost and rapid intraindustry dissemination of information about reputation, which enables it to use reputation bonds to create intraindustry norms that function as a deterrent to breach of contract and a private sanctioning system whose judgments can almost always be enforced completely outside the legal system.

qa_pairs.question: - 建立**声誉债券**制度，使交易方违约成本远高于履约成本，违约将导致未来交易机会的丧失 - Establish a **reputation bond** system where the cost of breach for transactors far exceeds the cost of performance, with breach leading to loss of future trading opportunities 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 该陈述并不完全准确。虽然声誉债券制度旨在提高违约成本，但理论上，当单次违约的收益超过净声誉损失时，违约风险依然存在。更重要的是，该制度存在一个关键问题：对违约方的声誉损害并不能直接补偿受害方，导致受害方很可能得不到充分赔偿。这个问题催生了频繁的重新谈判，并最终促使行业建立仲裁委员会等机构，通过直接裁定损害赔偿来弥补声誉债券制度的不足。
source: Although in theory the game may be unstable since there remains a risk of defection where the gains derived from breaching a single contract exceed the net reputational loss, in practice this is unlikely to happen since the largest stones are usually sold at public auction rather than in the club or private offices-not only to obtain a reliable market price, but also to minimize the prospect of opportunistic breach.

Another problem associated with the use of extralegal contracts enforced through reputation bonds is the cost of renegotiation, which is likely to take place quite frequently since the 'sanction [imposed in the event of breach] is much more likely substantially to undercompensate the promisee because implicit [extralegal] contract bonds often do not redound to the promisee's direct benefit.'

Although the damage to the promisor's reputation does not directly redound to the benefit of the promisee, this problem has been largely overcome (at least with respect to transactions between club members) by the creation of the floor committee and the board of arbitrators, both of which have the authority to award damages.

qa_pairs.question: 关键环节：设计双层私人仲裁与执行体系 Key Step: Design a two-tier private arbitration and enforcement system 1 True请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 论文证实，钻石行业确实设计了一套双层或多层的私人仲裁与执行体系。在纽约钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC），该体系由两个主要争议解决机构组成：场内委员会（Floor Committee）和仲裁委员会（Board of Arbitrators）。场内委员会作为第一层级，负责处理较轻微的违规行为，可以直接处以罚款或暂停交易资格，并作为正式仲裁的“守门人”，判断争议是否存在实质性的事实问题。仲裁委员会作为第二层级，处理更复杂的商业索赔。该体系的执行机制同样是分层的：首先，未遵守裁决的成员照片将被张贴在俱乐部内；其次，该信息将被通报给世界钻石交易所联盟（WFDB）的所有成员交易所，这些交易所均有义务执行其他成员的裁决，从而形成一个全球性的执行网络。
source: There are two dispute resolution bodies in the DDC, the Floor Committee and the Board of Arbitrators; both are composed of club members elected for two-year-terms.
Before a dispute is referred to arbitration, the Floor Committee must find that a material issue of fact exists.

The Floor Committee has the authority to exclude a member from the trading hall for up to twenty days and/or impose a fine of up to $1,000 when the member "fails to meet his commercial obligations to another member and no material issue of fact is involved or a member causes a disturbance or conducts himself in the clubrooms in a manner unbecoming a member of the club.

Any member of the DDC who has a claim "arising out of or related to the diamond business" against another member has the right to file a written complaint against the member who must then submit to DDC adjudication.

All decisions of arbitration panels including floor committee arbitrations which are not complied with within 10 working days, together with the picture of the non-complying member, shall be posted in a conspicuous place in the Club rooms.
This information is communicated to all bourses in the world federation. As a condition of membership in the federation, each bourse agrees to enforce the judgments of all member bourses.

qa_pairs.question: - **第一层：调解委员会**（Floor Committee）：处理简单纠纷，可处以罚款和短期禁入交易大厅 - **First tier: Floor Committee**: Handles simple disputes, with authority to impose fines and short-term trading hall bans 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文，钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）设有两个争议解决机构：场内委员会（Floor Committee）和仲裁员委员会（Board of Arbitrators）。场内委员会有权在成员“未能履行对另一成员的商业义务且不涉及重大事实问题”或行为不当时，将其逐出交易大厅最多二十天，并/或处以最高1000美元的罚款。这证实了场内委员会确实处理较简单的纠纷，并有权实施罚款和短期禁入交易大厅的处罚。
source: There are two dispute resolution bodies in the DDC, the Floor Committee and the Board of Arbitrators; both are composed of club members elected for two-year-terms.

The Floor Committee has the authority to exclude a member from the trading hall for up to twenty days and/or impose a fine of up to $1,000 when the member "fails to meet his commercial obligations to another member and no material issue of fact is involved or a member causes a disturbance or conducts himself in the clubrooms in a manner unbecoming a member of the club.

qa_pairs.question: - **第二层：仲裁委员会**（Board of Arbitrators）：处理复杂纠纷，可作出具有约束力的赔偿裁决，包括惩罚性赔偿 - **Second tier: Board of Arbitrators**: Handles complex disputes, with authority to issue binding compensation awards, including punitive damages 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 该陈述不完全准确。虽然仲裁委员会有权裁定包括惩罚性赔偿在内的任何损害赔偿，但它并非无条件处理所有复杂纠纷。根据其章程，交易所有权拒绝仲裁某些类型的案件，例如涉及“复杂的法定权利”或被认为处理起来“不方便”的案件。在这种情况下，仲裁委员会可以选择不审理案件，当事人则可以诉诸法院解决争议。
source: Unlike courts, whose award of damages is limited by either expectation damages or a valid liquidated damages clause, the DDC bylaws allow arbitrators to award any measure of damages they think is appropriate, including punitive damages.

In these cases, the arbitration panel either hears the case, or, if it falls into one of the four categories enumerated in the bylaws, the parties are left free to seek a resolution of their dispute in court.

Under its bylaws, the club has the right to refuse to arbitrate a claim when it does not arise out of the diamond business, or "(1) involves complicated statutory rights; (2) is 'forum nonconveniens' in that it is burdensome or inconvenient to handle the claim in the Club; (3) involves nonmembers; (4) has been conciliated, mediated, arbitrated or litigated outside the Club and/or the parties have sought remedies elsewhere; (5) is not in the ordinary course of commercial dealings."

qa_pairs.question: - **执行机制**：未及时履行仲裁裁决的会员信息将在全球交易所网络公示，并可实施长期禁入或驱逐 - **Enforcement mechanism**: Information of members failing to promptly comply with arbitration awards will be publicly notified across the global bourse network, with possible long-term suspension or expulsion 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 该陈述是错误的。根据论文，钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）确实有明确的执行机制来处理未履行仲裁裁决的会员。DDC章程规定，未在10个工作日内遵守仲裁裁决的会员，其照片和相关信息将在俱乐部房间的显眼位置张贴，并且此信息会通报给世界钻石交易所联盟的所有成员。仲裁委员会有权暂停或开除未能支付裁决金额的会员。尽管目前开除会员通常需要先获得法院的确认令，但将违约会员的照片和未付裁决的详情张贴在全球所有交易所的交易大厅，仍然是一项有效的制裁措施。
source: The DDC Bylaws provide that "[a]ll decisions of arbitration panels including floor committee arbitrations which are not complied with within 10 working days, together with the picture of the non-complying member, shall be posted in a conspicuous place in the Club rooms.
This information is communicated to all bourses in the world federation.

The arbitration board can also suspend or expel a member for failing to pay a judgment or failing to pay his diamond-related creditors without making special arrangements through the club's private bankruptcy system.

At present, a member is not expelled until the Board of Arbitrators first obtains a court order affirming its decision. Effective sanctions may still remain, however, since the member's picture, along with a description of the judgment that he refused to pay will still be hung in the club room and on the trading floor of every bourse in the world federation.

qa_pairs.question: 步骤3：制定行业特殊交易惯例与规则 Step 3: Develop industry-specific trading customs and rules 1 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 论文内容表明，钻石行业确实已经发展出一套详尽且特殊的交易惯例与规则，行业参与者认为这套体系优于国家法律体系。这些规则既有正式成文的，也有非正式但被广泛接受的。例如，钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）的交易规则明确规定，口头报盘在说出“Mazel and Broche”后即构成有约束力的协议。行业内的纠纷依据这些交易惯例和用法来解决，而非纽约州的合同与损害赔偿法。这些惯例和用法许多都详细规定在俱乐部的章程中，或是业内普遍知晓并接受的。整个私法体系是通过声誉纽带、商业惯例和仲裁程序等多种方式共同发展起来的。
source: In the diamond industry, a handshake accompanied by the words mazel u'broche creates a binding agreement.

Section One of the Trade Rules provides: "[a]ny oral offer is binding among dealers, when agreement is expressed by the accepted words 'Mazel and Broche' or any other words expressing the words of accord."
The DDC Board of Arbitrators does not apply the New York law of contract and damages, rather it resolves disputes on the basis of trade customs and usages.
Many of these are set forth with particularity in the club's bylaws, and others simply are generally known and accepted.

By a variety of reputational bonds, customary business practices, and arbitration proceedings, the diamond industry has developed a set of rules and institutions that its participants find clearly superior to the legal system.

qa_pairs.question: - 采用“mazel u'broche”口头协议形式，配合“open cachet”密封交易流程，形成具有约束力的非书面合同 - Adopt the oral agreement form of 'mazel u'broche' combined with the 'open cachet' sealed transaction process to form binding non-written contracts 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 与提问中的“False”判断相反，论文明确指出，在钻石行业中，口头语“mazel u'broche”能创造一个有约束力的协议。此外，“open cachet”是一种常见的交易模式，在此模式下，买方提出的要约在特定时间内具有约束力。卖方可以通过对买方说出“mazel and broche”来接受此要约，从而形成最终的约束性合同。因此，这两者的结合确实构成了有约束力的非书面合同。
source: In the diamond industry, a handshake accompanied by the words mazel u’broche creates a binding agreement.
The most common transactional paradigm is known as “open cachet.” ... Unless otherwise specified, this offer is considered binding on the offerer until one o’clock the next day.
The seller may accept at any time during this period by contacting the buyer and saying “mazel and broche.”

qa_pairs.question: - 建立**秘密仲裁**原则，只要裁决得到及时履行，争议的存在和结果将被严格保密，保护交易方声誉 - Establish the principle of **secret arbitration**, where the existence and outcome of disputes are strictly confidential as long as awards are promptly fulfilled, protecting transactors' reputations 2 False请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文，秘密仲裁确实是钻石行业争议解决体系的一个重要特征。仲裁程序是保密的，只要裁决得到遵守，仲裁的事实及其结果就会被官方保密。根据俱乐部的章程，争议的存在及其解决方案都会保密，前提是仲裁员的判决得到及时支付。这种做法旨在减少对相关方声誉的损害。
source: An important feature of the arbitration system is the secrecy of the proceedings.
As long as judgments are complied with, the fact of the arbitration as well as its outcome are officially kept secret.
Under the club's bylaws, the existence of a dispute and its resolution are kept secret so long as the arbitrators' judgment is paid promptly.

The reputation damage suffered by the promisee is reduced by the practice of keeping disputes secret after a judgment is rendered since other transactors may view mere participation in an arbitration as a signal that a dealer was unwilling to renegotiate deals when unforeseen circumstances arose; they might demand additional protections or charge a higher price when dealing with him in the future.

qa_pairs.question: 钻石行业成功构建了高效的**非法律合同执行机制** The diamond industry has successfully established an efficient **extralegal contractual enforcement mechanism** 钻石行业通过**声誉债券**、交易俱乐部（交易所）的私人仲裁系统和行业惯例，系统性地拒绝了国家法律体系，发展出一套内部规则和制裁措施来处理行业成员间的纠纷。这种机制比依赖法院系统更能满足行业对**保密性**、**快速争议解决**和**灵活损害赔偿**的需求，实现了低违约率和高效合同执行。 Through **reputation bonds**, private arbitration systems of trading clubs (bourses), and industry customs, the diamond industry has systematically rejected state legal systems and developed internal rules and sanctions to handle disputes among industry members. This mechanism better meets the industry's needs for **secrecy**, **rapid dispute resolution**, and **flexible damages** than relying on court systems, achieving low breach rates and efficient contract enforcement.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 钻石行业通过建立一个以声誉为基础的复杂内部系统，成功地实现了非法律合同的执行。该行业系统性地拒绝了国家法律，转而发展出一套内部规则、独特的机构和制裁措施。其核心是“声誉债券”，即交易商因违约而可能损失的未来交易利润的现值，交易所的仲裁系统利用这种债券来执行其判决。该机制满足了行业对保密性的高度需求，因为只要判决得到及时遵守，仲裁结果就会被保密，从而避免了可能暴露商业秘密的公开诉讼。此外，该系统确保了争议的快速解决，仲裁员被要求在听证会后十天内做出裁决，以最大限度地减少经济损失。在损害赔偿方面，仲裁员拥有比法院更大的灵活性，可以裁定任何他们认为合适的赔偿，包括惩罚性赔偿，以确保受害方得到充分补偿并威慑违约行为。最后，执行力极强：不遵守裁决的成员的照片将被张贴在俱乐部并通报给全球所有交易所，这几乎可以立即终结其业务。
source: The diamond industry has systematically rejected state-created law. In its place, the sophisticated traders who dominate the industry have developed an elaborate, internal set of rules, complete with distinctive institutions and sanctions, to handle disputes among industry members.
Sections IVD and E focus on the ways the industry's organization facilitates the creation of strong reputational bonds, which the bourse's arbitration system in turn uses to enforce its judgments.

The typical diamond transaction involves the posting of a reputation bond equal to the present value of the profit on future transactions that will not take place if the promisor breaches a contract, less his ability to cover.

Consequently, individual traders, fearful of litigation that might reveal trade practices, prefer to conclude transactions using agreements that are enforceable only in the bourse's arbitration tribunals, where the existence and outcome of a dispute are kept secret as long as the judgment is paid promptly.
The bourse's ability to resolve disputes promptly is considered so important that even if a dealer fails to appear for an arbitration, the hearing is held and he is bound by the panel's decision.

Unlike courts, whose award of damages is limited by either expectation damages or a valid liquidated damages clause, the DDC bylaws allow arbitrators to award any measure of damages they think is appropriate, including punitive damages.

Unlike a court, the DDC has the ability to bring unique pressures on the losing party to pay: it can put him out of business almost instantaneously by hanging his picture in the clubroom of every bourse in the world with a notice that he failed to pay his debt.

qa_pairs.question: 行业组织特征促进了声誉机制的有效运作 Industry organizational characteristics facilitate the effective operation of reputation mechanisms 钻石行业从传统的**同质化群体机制**（地理集中、种族同质的小群体重复交易）向**信息中介机制**（技术链接市场并确保声誉信息的快速低成本传播）过渡，同时保留了两种机制的优势。交易所作为商品和信息交换中心，通过会员资格、仲裁协议和信息传播网络增强了声誉债券的约束力，确保了非法律合同的执行。 The diamond industry is transitioning from a traditional **homogeneous group regime** (repeated transactions among small geographically concentrated and ethnically homogeneous groups) to an **information-intermediary regime** (technology links markets and secures rapid and low-cost dissemination of reputation information), while retaining the advantages of both regimes. As commodity and information exchange centers, bourses enhance the binding force of reputation bonds through membership资格, arbitration agreements, and information dissemination networks, ensuring the enforcement of extralegal contracts.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 钻石行业的组织结构通过建立强大的声誉纽带，促进了非法律契约制度的有效运作，而交易所的仲裁系统则利用这些声誉纽带执行其判决。该行业正从传统的“同质化群体机制”（即在地理集中、种族同质的小群体中进行重复交易）向“信息中介机制”（即利用技术连接市场，实现声誉信息的快速、低成本传播）过渡。目前，该行业成功地建立了一个能够同时捕获两种机制优势的系统：既利用小型社会团体（各个交易所）进行监督，也利用信息中介（如世界交易所联盟和经纪人）进行监督。作为商品和信息交换中心，交易所通过传播交易商的声誉信息，发挥着声誉信号和监督的双重功能。实际上，交易俱乐部及其仲裁系统的主要功能就是增强声誉纽带的运作，从而确保非法律协议的执行。
source: Sections IVD and $E$ focus on the ways the industry's organization facilitates the creation of strong reputational bonds, which the bourse's arbitration system in turn uses to enforce its judgments.

They examine two types of reputation-bond-based extralegal contractual regimes: the homogeneous group regime that is generally associated with repeat transactions among members of small geographically concentrated and ethnically homogeneous groups, and the information-intermediary regime in which technology links markets and secures the rapid and low-cost dissemination of information about reputation.
The diamond industry is currently in transition; it is moving from a homogeneous-group-based, extralegal contractual regime to one that relies increasingly on information technology.

it has succeeded, at least for the time being, in creating a system that is designed to capture the benefits of both monitoring by small social groups (individual bourses) and monitoring achieved through information intermediaries (institutions such as the world federation and brokers).
The bourse is an information exchange as much as it is a commodities exchange.
The bourse facilitates the transmission of information about dealers' reputations and, at least with respect to members, serves both a reputation-signaling and a reputation-monitoring function.
The main function of both the club and its arbitration system is to enhance the functioning of reputation bonds.

qa_pairs.question: Robert C. Ellickson的财富最大化规范假说 Robert C. Ellickson's Hypothesis of Wealth Maximizing Norms 该假说认为，当人们处于紧密联系的群体中时，他们倾向于为日常问题发展出财富最大化的规范，为本文分析钻石行业的私人治理机制提供了理论框架。 This hypothesis suggests that when people are situated in a close-knit group, they will tend to develop wealth-maximizing norms for ordinary problems, providing a theoretical framework for analyzing the diamond industry's private governance mechanisms.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 该论文明确引用了Robert C. Ellickson的财富最大化规范假说，即“当人们处于紧密联系的群体中时，他们倾向于为日常问题发展出财富最大化的规范”。钻石行业通过其“同质群体”（homogeneous-group）的超法律合同制度体现了这一假说，这种制度利用了预先存在的社会关系，而无需大量额外投资来建立约束。该私人治理体系得以存续的条件是，它必须比现有的法律体系更优越（帕累托最优）。一个具体的例子是，行业内“诚实守信”的规范之所以被遵守，是因为这些品质被视为“对生意有益，是盈利的一种方式”。
source: A similar thesis is advanced by Robert C. Ellickson, A Hypothesis of Wealth Maximizing Norms: Evidence from the Whaling Industry, 5 J. L. Econ. & Org. 83, 84 (1989), where he explores the "hypothesis that when people are situated in a close knit group, they will tend to develop for the ordinary run of problems norms that are wealth maximizing."
The private regime must be Pareto superior to the established legal regime in order to survive.

In general, homogeneous-group-based, extralegal contractual regimes are more likely to arise when "preexisting or gradually evolving social relationships provide a basis for nonlegal [extralegal] commitment[s] without large additional investments in developing a bond . . .

As an elderly Israeli diamond dealer explained, "when I first entered the business, the conception was that truth and trust were simply the way to do business, and nobody decent would consider doing it differently. Although many transactions are still consummated on the basis of trust and truthfulness, this is done because these qualities are viewed as good for business, a way to make a profit."

qa_pairs.question: John Gray对Hayek自发秩序理论的阐释 John Gray's Interpretation of Hayek's Spontaneous Order Theory 该理论强调文化进化中不同传统和实践的竞争选择，解释了钻石行业私人规则如何通过竞争和自然选择过程形成并保持效率。 This theory emphasizes the competitive selection of different traditions and practices in cultural evolution, explaining how private rules in the diamond industry emerge and maintain efficiency through competition and natural selection.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文，John Gray对哈耶克自发秩序理论的阐释为理解钻石行业的私人治理体系提供了理论框架。该理论认为，文化可以被视为不同传统和实践之间的竞争，其中自然选择过程会发生，这至少部分可以通过它们作为知识载体或体现的相对效率来解释。为了在这种竞争中生存下来，钻石行业的私人制度必须比既定的法律制度更优越（帕累托最优）。该行业在拥有各种法律规则和制度的国家中，几代钻石商都固守着几乎相同的行业内部规范，这表明这些传统规则和制度从市场内部人士的角度来看可能是高效的。在美国，这些传统规则和制度经受住了时间的考验，并证明了其相对于既定法律制度的优越性。
source: For a broader and more theoretical articulation of this thesis, see generally, John Gray, Hayek on Liberty (2d ed. 1986), discussing Hayek's theory of spontaneous order and the "competitive selection of rules and practices," particularly, "Hayek's assertion that the evolution of culture may itself be fruitfully investigated in terms of the competition between different traditions or practices, with a natural selection among them occurring which is at least partly to be explained by their relative efficiency as bearers or embodiments of knowledge."
The private regime must be Pareto superior to the established legal regime in order to survive.

That generations of diamond dealers have clung to nearly identical intraindustry norms in countries with a wide variety of legal rules and institutions suggests that the traditional rules and institutions are likely to be efficient from the perspective of market insiders.
In the United States, the traditional rules and institutions endured over time and demonstrated their superiority to the established legal regime.

qa_pairs.question: David Charny的非法律制裁理论 David Charny's Theory of Nonlegal Sanctions 该理论分析了商业关系中非法律制裁的作用，特别是声誉机制如何有效约束行为，为理解钻石行业依赖声誉债券而非法律合同提供了关键视角。 This theory analyzes the role of nonlegal sanctions in commercial relationships, particularly how reputation mechanisms effectively constrain behavior, providing a key perspective for understanding why the diamond industry relies on reputation bonds rather than legal contracts.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文对David Charny理论的引用，非法律制裁在商业关系中通过多种机制发挥作用。首先，当这些制裁“依附于文化中既有的背景习惯或理解”时，它们的成本会更低，因为它们利用了预先存在的社会关系来建立承诺。其次，Charny指出，一个基于声誉的超法律合同制度不仅限于同质化的小团体，在大型市场中也能运作，前提是存在“信息中介”，如利用技术廉价地向大量交易者传递信息。此外，该理论还区分了不同类型的社会纽带，例如，牺牲“次级社会纽带”可能会导致个人层面的损失，如丧失自尊或产生负罪感。然而，Charny也指出了一个问题：声誉债券的制裁效果（即对违约者声誉的损害）通常不会直接使受害方受益，这可能导致受害方补偿不足，从而引发频繁的重新谈判。
source: When a secondary social bond is sacrificed, a dealer may experience, "loss of opportunities for important or pleasurable associations with others, loss of self-esteem, feelings of guilt, or an unfulfilled desire to think of himself as trustworthy and competent.

Charny has noted, however, that a reputation-bond-based, extralegal contractual regime will function even in large scale markets so long as "technology . . . such as computers used to monitor credit worthiness, or mass media used in advertising, [make it possible to] convey information cheaply to a large group of transactors . . . [that is] when a thick set of informational intermediaries" exists.

In general, homogeneous-group-based, extralegal contractual regimes are more likely to arise when "preexisting or gradually evolving social relationships provide a basis for nonlegal [extralegal] commitment[s] without large additional investments in developing a bond . . . [since they are] incrementally less costly as nonlegal [extralegal] sanctions when they are parasitic on background habits or understandings built into the culture in which these bonds are formed."

Another problem associated with the use of extralegal contracts enforced through reputation bonds is the cost of renegotiation, which is likely to take place quite frequently since the "sanction [imposed in the event of breach] is much more likely substantially to undercompensate the promisee because implicit [extralegal] contract bonds often do not redound to the promisee's direct benefit.

qa_pairs.question: 纽约钻石交易俱乐部(DDC)章程与仲裁规则 New York Diamond Dealers Club (DDC) Bylaws and Arbitration Rules 详细规定了会员资格、争议解决程序、仲裁机制及执行措施，是钻石行业私人治理体系的核心制度文件，为本文描述行业自治机制提供了直接依据。 Detailed provisions on membership qualifications, dispute resolution procedures, arbitration mechanisms, and enforcement measures, serving as the core institutional document of the diamond industry's private governance system and providing direct evidence for describing the industry's self-regulatory mechanisms.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 纽约钻石交易俱乐部（DDC）的章程与仲裁规则构成了该行业私人治理体系的基础。作为会员资格的先决条件，交易商必须签署协议，同意将所有源于钻石业务的争议提交给俱乐部的仲裁系统。该仲裁协议具有约束力，会员若试图诉诸法庭将面临罚款或被开除。DDC仲裁委员会不采用纽约州的合同与损害赔偿法，而是依据行业惯例和惯例来解决争端。章程规定，俱乐部有权拒绝受理某些案件，例如涉及复杂法定权利、非会员或已在别处处理的争议。其执行机制十分有力：未在10个工作日内履行的仲裁裁决，将导致违规会员的照片被张贴在俱乐部房间的显眼位置，并通报给世界钻石交易所联盟的所有成员，各成员交易所有义务相互执行裁决。仲裁委员会还有权因会员未能支付判决款项而暂停其资格或将其开除。此外，DDC还设有与民事破产法并行的强制性私人破产程序，该程序不允许“债务豁免”，要求债务人必须为其100%的债务偿还做出安排。
source: As a condition of membership, a dealer must sign an agreement to submit all disputes arising from the diamond business between himself and another member to the club's arbitration system.

The agreement to arbitrate is binding. Unless the club opts not to hear the case, the member may not seek redress of his grievances in court. If he does so, he will be fined or expelled from the club.
The DDC Board of Arbitrators does not apply the New York law of contract and damages, rather it resolves disputes on the basis of trade customs and usages.

Under its bylaws, the club has the right to refuse to arbitrate a claim when it does not arise out of the diamond business, or "(1) involves complicated statutory rights; (2) is 'forum nonconveniens' in that it is burdensome or inconvenient to handle the claim in the Club; (3) involves nonmembers; (4) has been conciliated, mediated, arbitrated or litigated outside the Club and/or the parties have sought remedies elsewhere; (5) is not in the ordinary course of commercial dealings."

The DDC Bylaws provide that "[a]ll decisions of arbitration panels including floor committee arbitrations which are not complied with within 10 working days, together with the picture of the non-complying member, shall be posted in a conspicuous place in the Club rooms.
This information is communicated to all bourses in the world federation. As a condition of membership in the federation, each bourse agrees to enforce the judgments of all member bourses.

The arbitration board can also suspend or expel a member for failing to pay a judgment or failing to pay his diamond-related creditors without making special arrangements through the club's private bankruptcy system.

Unlike the arbitration system, which operates in place of a public trial, the DDC's bankruptcy rules and procedures do not supplant civil bankruptcy law; they provide instead a parallel set of rules that are mandatory for club members:
There is no such thing as "discharge" under the private bankruptcy rules: "All debtors must make provisions for the payment of one hundred percent ( 100% ) of his/her debt"

qa_pairs.question: 世界钻石交易所联合会(WFDB)章程与内部规则 World Federation of Diamond Bourses (WFDB) Bylaws and Inner Rules 规定了国际钻石交易的统一标准、跨交易所争议解决及仲裁裁决执行机制，支撑了本文关于行业全球协调治理的分析。 Specifies uniform standards for international diamond trading, cross-bourse dispute resolution, and enforcement mechanisms for arbitration awards, supporting the analysis of the industry's globally coordinated governance.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 世界钻石交易所联合会（WFDB）通过其章程和内部规则，为全球钻石行业建立了协调治理框架。该联合会要求其成员交易所采纳相似的交易规则，并设有自己的仲裁系统来解决成员间的纠纷。为了处理跨交易所的争议，联合会维持一个仲裁员委员会，该委员会有权解决交易所之间的争端，或审理来自不同交易所的诉讼当事人之间的案件。作为联合会成员资格的一项条件，每个交易所都必须执行其他成员交易所的仲裁裁决。为了进一步促进全球标准的统一，联合会还提议建立一个包含仲裁原则的计算机数据库，以推动全球仲裁裁决的一致性并防止“择地行诉”。
source: Each bourse has similar trade rules, and, like the individual bourses, the WFDB has an arbitration system to resolve differences between its members.

As a condition of membership in the federation, each bourse is required to enforce the arbitration judgments of other member bourses to the extent permitted by the law of the country in which it operates.

The world federation maintains a board of arbitrators that has the authority to settle disputes between bourses or to hear cases between private litigants from different bourses when there is a colorable question as to which party's bourse should hear the case.

For more information on the rules of the World Federation, see World Federation of Diamond Bourses: Bye-Laws and Inner Rules (unpublished report, World Federation of Diamond Bourses, November 15, 1988).
The WFDB recently proposed compiling a computer data base of these statements of principle to promote worldwide uniformity of arbitrated judgments and to prevent "forum shopping."

qa_pairs.question: 钻石交易规则与商业惯例 Diamond Trading Rules and Commercial Customs 包括口头合同成立的'mazel u'broche'习俗、'open cachet'交易范式等，构成了钻石行业非法律合同关系的实践基础，是本文论证行业偏离法律体系的关键例证。 Including customs such as 'mazel u'broche' for oral contract formation and the 'open cachet' transaction paradigm, forming the practical basis of extralegal contractual relations in the diamond industry and serving as key examples of the industry's deviation from the legal system.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 钻石行业的非法律合同关系建立在一套独特的商业惯例和交易规则之上，这些是其偏离正式法律体系的核心实践。其中，口头合同的成立极具代表性：一句“mazel u'broche”伴随握手即可构成有约束力的协议，这一习俗已被写入交易规则。最常见的交易范式是“open cachet”，即买方将意向钻石与写有出价条款和日期的纸条一同放入信封，折叠密封后在封口处签名。此举构成了一个在次日下午一点前对出价人有约束力的要约。在此期间，卖方可通过联系买方并说出“mazel and broche”来接受要约；但若卖方拒绝或提出还价，其接受原要约的权利即告取消。为防止卖方在“cachet”期间将钻石展示给其他买家，信封的封口签名起到了威慑作用，使违规行为易于被发现。
source: In the diamond industry, a handshake accompanied by the words mazel u'broche creates a binding agreement.

Section One of the Trade Rules provides: "[a]ny oral offer is binding among dealers, when agreement is expressed by the accepted words 'Mazel and Broche' or any other words expressing the words of accord."

The most common transactional paradigm is known as "open cachet." When a buyer makes an offer to a seller or a broker, the stone is put in an envelope which is then folded and sealed in a precise way. The terms and conditions of the offer are placed on the envelope as is the date. The buyer then signs the parcel across the seal. Unless otherwise specified, this offer is considered binding on the offerer until one o'clock the next day.

The seller may accept at any time during this period by contacting the buyer and saying "mazel and broche." If, however, the seller either rejects the offer or makes a counteroffer during this period, his option to accept the buyer's original offer is canceled.

Although it is improper for the seller to show the stone to another buyer while it is still under cachet, the wrapper is signed across the seal to discourage this and make its violation known to the buyer.

qa_pairs.question: 钻石行业交易模式与纠纷解决统计 Diamond Industry Trading Patterns and Dispute Resolution Statistics 约150起/年争议提交DDC仲裁，其中85%通过调解解决，仅有30-40起进入裁决程序，证明了行业纠纷解决机制的高效性和偏好合作解决的特点。 Approximately 150 disputes per year are submitted to DDC arbitration, with 85% settled through conciliation and only 30-40 proceeding to judgment, demonstrating the efficiency of the industry's dispute resolution mechanism and preference for cooperative solutions.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文，每年约有150起争议被提交至钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）的仲裁系统。其中，估计有85%的案件在强制性的仲裁前调解程序中得到解决。因此，每年只有30到40起案件最终进入裁决阶段。这种高和解率反映了行业内对自愿解决纠纷的偏好，其程序规则旨在赋予当事人对纠纷解决过程的控制权并创造经济激励来促成和解。此外，许多交易商认为仲裁员有“平分分歧”的倾向，其裁决的不可预测性也成为他们自行解决争议的重要动机。
source: Around 150 disputes per year are submitted to the DDC's arbitration system.
Of these, an estimated 85 percent are settled during the mandatory prearbitration conciliation procedure.
The DDC's procedural rules clearly reflect the industry's preference for the voluntary resolution of disputes.
The bylaws are structured to give the parties control over the dispute resolution process and to create financial incentives to settle.

Many dealers feel that the arbitrators have redistributive instincts; they cite the unpredictability of the decisions as well as the arbitrators' tendency to "split the difference" as an important motivation to settle their disputes on their own.
This may be a reason why, while 150 arbitration complaints are filed each year, only thirty to forty go to judgment.

qa_pairs.question: 钻石交易俱乐部会员结构与运作 Structure and Operation of Diamond Trading Clubs 纽约DDC拥有2000名会员，80%的美国进口 rough钻石和15-20%的 polished钻石通过其会员交易，显示了交易所在行业中的核心地位和信息中介功能。 The New York DDC has 2000 members, with 80% of U.S. imported rough diamonds and 15-20% of polished diamonds traded through its members, demonstrating the exchange's central role and information intermediary function in the industry.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 纽约钻石交易俱乐部（DDC）拥有2000名会员，是美国最大且最重要的交易俱乐部。其核心地位体现在巨大的交易量上：约80%进入美国的毛坯钻石和15-20%的抛光钻石经由其会员之手。该俱乐部不仅是商品交易所，更是一个信息交易所，通过高效的“小道消息”网络传递关于交易商声誉的信息，并发挥着声誉信号和声誉监控的双重功能。对于缺乏标准化价格信息的毛坯钻石市场，交易大厅是唯一能感受市场价格的地方。会员资格要求严格，包括从业经验和同意将所有商业纠纷提交给俱乐部内部仲裁系统。
source: The New York DDC currently has 2,000 members; in most years there is a waiting list for admission.
Approximately 80 percent of the rough diamonds coming into the United States pass through the hands of a DDC member, as do 15-20 percent of the polished stones.
The bourse is an information exchange as much as it is a commodities exchange.
The bourse facilitates the transmission of information about dealers' reputations and, at least with respect to members, serves both a reputation-signaling and a reputation-monitoring function.
Larger dealers will, however, come to the club's trading hall to get a feel for market prices.

Although a price list is available for certain classes of polished stones, the bourse's trading floor is the only place to obtain a feel for the market price of rough diamonds: standardized price information is unavailable.
As a condition of membership, a dealer must sign an agreement to submit all disputes arising from the diamond business between himself and another member to the club's arbitration system.

qa_pairs.question: DeBeers卡特尔的市场控制 Market Control by the DeBeers Cartel 控制全球80-85%的 rough钻石供应，通过'sight holders'系统分配钻石，影响了行业的信用结构和交易模式，为分析行业特殊经济结构提供了背景。 Controlling 80-85% of global rough diamond supply and distributing diamonds through the 'sight holders' system, influencing the industry's credit structure and trading patterns, providing context for analyzing the industry's unique economic structure.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: DeBeers卡特尔控制着全球80-85%的毛坯钻石供应，并通过一个名为“看货商”（sight holders）的系统进行分销。该系统每年在伦敦举行十次“看货会”（sights），向约150-200名指定交易商出售预先分拣好的钻石。看货商在看货会上获得一盒钻石并被告知价格，此价格不可协商，拒绝购买将导致其不被邀请参加后续的看货会。卡特尔积极监控看货商的决策和活动，并用更优质的钻石奖励遵守其“规则”的看货商。由于大部分监控成本由卡特尔承担，看货商通常能更容易地获得银行资本，因为成为看货商本身就是一种良好信用风险的信号。
source: At present, 80-85 percent of the world's supply of rough diamonds is controlled by the DeBeers Cartel.

The cartel distributes its supply of rough diamonds through four brokers. The brokers then sell presorted boxes of diamonds to some 150-200 dealers, known as sight holders, during ten viewing sessions, or sights, held in London each year.
At a sight, a dealer is given a box of diamonds and informed of its price. This price is nonnegotiable. If the dealer decides not to purchase his box, he will not be invited to subsequent sights.
The cartel actively monitors the decisions and activities of sight holders; if a sight holder continues to play by the cartel's "rules," he is rewarded with a more profitable selection of stones.
Consequently, because most monitoring costs are shifted to the cartel, sight holders generally have access to bank capital.
The fact that a dealer is a sight holder sends a signal to the bank that he is a good credit risk.

qa_pairs.question: Goldfinger v. Lisker (1985) Goldfinger v. Lisker (1985) 纽约法院撤销DDC仲裁裁决的案例，确立了仲裁程序公正性审查标准，反映了法律系统对行业自治的有限干预，支持了本文关于法律与非法律系统互动的分析。 A New York court case vacating a DDC arbitration award, establishing standards for reviewing the fairness of arbitration procedures, reflecting limited legal system intervention in industry self-governance and supporting analysis of interactions between legal and extralegal systems.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据论文，纽约州法院可以介入钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）的仲裁裁决，但仅限于审查程序上的不当行为。在“Goldfinger v. Lisker”一案中，法院正是基于此原则撤销了一项DDC仲裁裁决。尽管DDC的章程授权仲裁员调查事实，但法院裁定这并不意味着允许仲裁员进行单方面的庭外沟通（ex parte communication）。此案例表明，法律系统虽然承认行业自治，但仍会为了保障程序公正（如避免偏见和不当沟通）而进行干预。
source: The decisions of the arbitration board can be appealed to New York State court under New York law, but arbitration awards can only be vacated for procedural irregularities, such as an arbitrator engaging in an ex parte communication or a failure to allow the parties to be represented by counsel.

See, for example, Goldfinger v. Lisker, 508 N.Y.S.2d 159 (on a motion to confirm a DDC arbitration award the court granted a cross motion to vacate the award on the grounds that, while the DDC Bylaws do authorize arbitrators to investigate the facts, ex parte communications with arbitrators are not thereby sanctioned).
In addition, New York law requires that the arbitration process be free from the appearance of bias.

qa_pairs.question: Rabinowitz v. Olewski (1984) Rabinowitz v. Olewski (1984) 法院因潜在偏见暂停DDC仲裁的案例，揭示了行业仲裁中可能存在的程序问题，为本文讨论仲裁机制的局限性提供了依据。 A case where the court stayed DDC arbitration due to potential bias, revealing possible procedural issues in industry arbitration and providing a basis for discussing limitations of arbitration mechanisms.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 在Rabinowitz v. Olewski (1984)一案中，法院基于纽约州法律要求仲裁程序必须避免出现偏见的规定，下令暂停了钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）的仲裁。起因是俱乐部内出现一封信，指控原告同情巴勒斯坦解放组织。法院认为，若由“以犹太人为主的DDC”审理此案，可能会因“不正当的表象和偏见的幽灵”而导致实质性的不公，因此指示案件应由独立仲裁员审理。这揭示了行业内部仲裁机制在面对可能引发群体偏见时，其程序公正性会受到外部司法系统的挑战和限制。
source: In addition, New York law requires that the arbitration process be free from the appearance of bias.

See, for example, Rabinowitz v. Olewski, 100 A.D.2d 539; 473 N.Y. 2 d 232 (2d Dept 1984) (where the court ordered a stay of DDC arbitration and directed that the case be heard by an independent arbitrator after a letter surfaced in the club accusing the plaintiff of being sympathetic to the Palestine Liberation Organization; since it was clear that a substantial injustice might result were the case heard by the predominantly Jewish DDC and there was the "appearance of impropriety and specter of bias among the DDC").

qa_pairs.question: Martin Rapaport与DDC的争议(1980年代初) Martin Rapaport's Dispute with DDC (Early 1980s) 该争议导致DDC更谨慎地行使驱逐权并增加法律代表参与仲裁，标志着法律干预开始影响行业自治，是本文分析制度变迁的重要案例。 This dispute led DDC to exercise expulsion power more cautiously and increase legal representation in arbitration, marking the beginning of legal intervention affecting industry self-governance and serving as an important case for analyzing institutional change.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 在1980年代初，钻石交易商俱乐部（DDC）以发表负面公开言论为由驱逐了马丁·拉帕波特（Martin Rapaport），但真实原因在于俱乐部反对他发布的钻石价格表。拉帕波特通过在法庭上挑战其驱逐决定，打破了行业的“保密规范”，这是首例因仲裁决定分歧以外的原因对俱乐部提起的诉讼。此争议带来了深远影响：DDC在行使驱逐权时变得更为谨慎，担心被驱逐成员提起诉讼并再次引起联邦贸易委员会的关注，因此现在DDC在驱逐成员前会先寻求法院命令确认其决定。此外，在此案之后，律师代表在仲裁中从罕见变为常态。最终，拉帕波特与俱乐部达成和解并被重新接纳为会员。
source: In the early 1980s the DDC Board of Directors exercised their authority to expel a member from the club for making public statements that tended to cast the industry in a negative light. They expelled Martin Rapaport for saying to the press, "diamonds, ethics, Feh! If the devil himself showed up they would sell to him." The real reason the club wanted to expel Rapaport, however, was that they were opposed to his price list.
Rapaport challenged his expulsion in court but ultimately settled with the club on undisclosed terms and was readmitted as a member.

Ever since Martin Rapaport decided to break the secrecy norm, however, by initiating the first suit against the club for any reason other than disagreement with an arbitration decision, there has been a profound change in the way the club decides cases and enforces judgments.

The Rapaport controversy has made the club much more reluctant to expel membersit is concerned not only about the expelled member bringing suit, but it also fears that too many expulsions will revive the Federal Trade Commission's interest in its activities.
At present, a member is not expelled until the Board of Arbitrators first obtains a court order affirming its decision.
Although the DDC bylaws have always given the litigants the right to be represented by a lawyer, prior to the Rapaport case it was uncommon. Today, legal representation is the norm.

qa_pairs.question: 钻石经销商访谈(1989年夏) Diamond Dealer Interviews (Summer 1989) 资深以色列钻石经销商指出，行业中 A senior Israeli diamond dealer noted that in the industry, 'truth and trust were simply the way to do business,' reflecting the internal perception of reputation's market value and supporting the analysis of reputation-based governance.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 根据1989年夏天对一位资深以色列钻石经销商的访谈，论文指出，在钻石行业中，“信任”和“声誉”具有实际的市场价值。这位经销商解释说，虽然他刚入行时，“真实和信任”被认为是理所当然的经商方式，但现在这种观念已经转变。如今，尽管许多交易仍然基于信任和诚实，但这更多是因为这些品质被视为“对生意有益，是盈利的一种方式”。
source: In the diamond industry, "trust" and "reputation" have an actual market value.

As an elderly Israeli diamond dealer explained, "when I first entered the business, the conception was that truth and trust were simply the way to do business, and nobody decent would consider doing it differently.
Although many transactions are still consummated on the basis of trust and truthfulness, this is done because these qualities are viewed as good for business, a way to make a profit."
Interview with author, summer 1989.

qa_pairs.question: Merchants Bank of New York官员观点 Views of Merchants Bank of New York Officials 强调在钻石行业信贷评估中， Emphasized that in diamond industry credit evaluation, 'character is the most important C' among the three C's (Capital, Culpability, Character), demonstrating the importance of reputation in the industry's implicit capital market.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 在钻石行业，由于宝石估值困难，许多贷款决策实际上是基于银行对交易商市场声誉的看法。纽约商人银行（Merchants Bank of New York）的一位官员解释说，在信贷评估中，银行关注“3个C”——资本（Capital）、责任（Culpability）和品格（Character），并认为“品格是最重要的C”。因此，对钻石交易商而言，违约对其信用评级的损害更为严重，因为行业内少数贷款方在评估其资产时更依赖于交易商的声誉。
source: Consequently, many loan decisions are really made on the basis of the bank's perception of the dealer's reputation in the marketplace.

As an officer of the Merchants Bank of New York (located in the middle of Forty-seventh Street) explained, " `[i]`n terms of extending credit a bank has to look at the 3 C's-Capital, Culpability, and Character. At our bank, we think that character is the most important C."

Thus, although defaulting on a loan would hurt any businessman's credit rating, the damage to a diamond dealer is more severe since there are only a few industry lenders and banks must rely to a greater extent on the dealers' reputation in valuing his assets.

name: Propagation of Chaos for 2D Log Gas on the Whole Space

qa_pairs.question: 传播混沌 Propagation of Chaos 指当粒子数量趋于无穷大时，粒子系统中任意有限子集的联合分布收敛到相应数量独立随机变量的乘积分布的现象。在本文中，它描述了二维Log气体系统中粒子从初始相关性逐渐变为统计独立的过程，是平均场极限理论的核心概念。 The phenomenon where the joint distribution of any finite subset of particles in a system converges to the product distribution of the corresponding number of independent random variables as the number of particles tends to infinity. In this paper, it describes the process by which particles in a 2D Log gas system gradually become statistically independent from initial correlations, serving as a core concept in mean-field limit theory.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 在本文中，“传播混沌”被精确地描述为N粒子系统（公式1.1）向McKean-Vlasov系统（公式1.3）的收敛过程。为推导此结果，作者采用了“调制自由能方法”（modulated free energy method），其核心思想是传播并控制粒子系统联合分布（ρN）与极限密度（ρ̄）之间的调制自由能。该能量是相对熵与调制能量的加权组合。本文的主要贡献在于，通过为极限方程（1.4）的解建立对数增长估计，将此方法从环面（torus）扩展到整个二维空间（whole space），从而首次获得了二维Log气体在全空间上的定量传播混沌结果。最终的定量结果体现在定理1.1中，该定理给出了相对熵H_N(ρN|ρ̄N)(t)随时间演化的一个上界。
source: The convergence from the particle system (1.1) towards the McKean-Vlasov system (1.3) is usually termed as mean field limit and can be described precisely by Propagation of Chaos in mathematics literature.
We shall apply the so-called modulated free energy method introduced in [BJW19a, BJW23] to derive the propagation of chaos result for the particle system (1.1).

The main idea of this paper relies on propagating and controlling the modulated free energy between the joint distribution $\rho_{N}$ or the empirical measure $\mu_{N}$ under the law $\rho_{N}$, i.e. ... and the limiting density $\bar{\rho}$, which combines the relative entropy introduced by Jabin-Wang [JW18] and the modulated energy introduced by Serfaty [Ser20] and Duerinckx [Due15].

Briefly speaking, our main contribution is to extend this modulated free energy method, which has been used in [BJW19a] for the 2D Coulomb gas on the torus case, to the 2 D whole space by obtaining the logarithimic growth estimates for the solution of the limit equation (1.4), which leads to the first quantitative convergence from the $N$-particle system (1.1) towards the limit McKean-Vlasov system (1.3) on $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ with any $\beta>0$.

Theorem 1.1 (Entropic Propagation of Chaos). Assume that $\rho_{N}$ is an entropy solution to the Liouville equation (1.5) and that $\bar{\rho} \in L^{\infty}([0, T], L^{1} \cap L^{\infty}(\mathbb{R}^{2}))$ solves the limit equation (1.4) with $\bar{\rho} \geq 0$ and $\int_{\mathbb{R}^{2}} \bar{\rho}(x, t) d x=1$. ... Then we have

$$ 
\mathcal{H}_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)(t) \leq C e^{\frac{C}{\varepsilon} t^{\varepsilon}}\left(E_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)(0)+\frac{1}{N}\right)
$$

qa_pairs.question: 调制自由能 Modulated Free Energy 一种结合了相对熵和调制能量的加权相对熵形式，用于分析粒子系统的联合分布与极限系统的张量积分布之间的差异。其定义为$E_N(\rho_N|\bar{\rho}_N)=\mathcal{H}_N(\rho_N|\bar{\rho}_N)+\frac{1}{\beta}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{dN}}F_N(\mu_N,\bar{\rho})\rho_N dX^N$，其中$\mathcal{H}_N$是归一化相对熵，$F_N$是调制能量。这种方法能够有效处理库仑相互作用中的奇异性，是证明定量混沌传播的关键工具。 A weighted relative entropy form that combines relative entropy and modulated energy to analyze the difference between the joint distribution of a particle system and the tensor product distribution of the limit system. It is defined as $E_N(\rho_N|\bar{\rho}_N)=\mathcal{H}_N(\rho_N|\bar{\rho}_N)+\frac{1}{\beta}\int_{\mathbb{R}^{dN}}F_N(\mu_N,\bar{\rho})\rho_N dX^N$, where $\mathcal{H}_N$ is the normalized relative entropy and $F_N$ is the modulated energy. This method effectively handles singularities in Coulomb interactions and is a key tool for proving quantitative propagation of chaos.请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 调制自由能（Modulated Free Energy）是一种分析方法，它将相对熵与调制能量相结合，用于处理具有奇异相互作用核的粒子系统。其具体定义为 $E_{N}(\rho_{N} | \bar{\rho}_{N})=\mathcal{H}_{N}(\rho_{N} | \bar{ho}_{N})+\frac{1}{ eta} \int_{\mathbb{R}^{d N}} F_{N}(\mu_{N}, \bar{\rho}) \rho_{N} \mathrm{~d} X^{N}$，其中 $\mathcal{H}_{N}$ 是粒子系统联合分布 $\rho_N$ 与极限系统张量积分布 $\bar{\rho}_N$ 之间的归一化相对熵，而 $F_N$ 是经验测度 $\mu_N$ 与极限密度 $\bar{\rho}$ 之间的调制能量。这种加权组合的关键优势在于，它能在计算时间导数时精确抵消奇异项 $\operatorname{div} K(x-y)$，同时保持相对熵的矫顽性。此外，调制自由能也可被理解为一种与吉布斯平衡相关的加权相对熵，或是在另一种形式下，作为联合分布与一个“调制吉布斯测度” $\mathbb{Q}_{N, \beta}(\bar{\rho})$ 之间的相对熵。
source:
Now we introduce the modulated free energy $E_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)$ on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ with general dimension $d$ as follows,

$$ E_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)=\mathcal{H}_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)+\frac{1}{\beta} \int_{\mathbb{R}^{d N}} F_{N}\left(\mu_{N}, \bar{\rho}\right) \rho_{N} \mathrm{~d} X^{N} $$

where $X^{N}=\left(x_{1}, \ldots, x_{N}\right)$ and $\mathcal{H}_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)$ is exactly the normalized relative entropy between the joint law $\rho_{N}$ and the tensorized law $\bar{\rho}_{N}$ on the whole space:
and $F_{N}\left(\mu_{N}, \bar{\rho}\right)$ is the modulated energy between the empirical measure $\mu_{N}$ and the limit density $\bar{\rho}$ :

Hence in the series of work by Bresch-Jabin-Wang [BJW19b, BJW19a, BJW23], the above two quantites are combined with appropriate weights, which cancels exactly the singular term $\operatorname{div} K(x-y)$ in the computation of time derivative, but still preserves the coerciveness over the relative entropy.
The quantity $E_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)$ can also be understood as the normalized relative entropy with two weights related to the Gibbs equilibrium, i.e.

Besides the form (1.9) of some weighted relative entropy, the structure of modulated free energy has another inspiring form which appears in [RS23b], say the relative entropy between the joint law and the Gibbs-type measure for the limit density,

$$ E_{N}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \bar{\rho}_{N}\right)=\frac{1}{\beta}\left(\mathcal{H}\left(\rho_{N} \mid \mathbb{Q}_{N, \beta}(\bar{\rho})\right)+\frac{\log K_{N, \beta}(\bar{\rho})}{N}\right) $$

where the new measure

$$ \mathbb{Q}_{N, \beta}(\bar{\rho})=\frac{1}{K_{N, \beta}(\bar{\rho})} e^{-N F_{N}\left(\mu_{N}, \bar{\rho}\right)} \mathrm{d} \bar{\rho}_{N} $$

is called the modulated Gibbs measure

qa_pairs.question: 传统方法的局限性 Limitation of Traditional Methods **相对熵方法**和**调制能量方法**在处理二维库仑气体系统时存在互补性局限：前者依赖于扩散项的正粘性产生负Fisher信息项，但无法处理**div K(x-y)** 奇异性；后者适用于无扩散的库仑相互作用，但难以证明强混沌传播。单独使用任一方法均无法解决二维全空间对数气体系统的定量分析问题。 **Relative entropy method** and **modulated energy method** have complementary limitations in handling 2D Coulomb gas systems: the former relies on positive viscosity of diffusion terms to generate negative Fisher information terms but fails to handle **div K(x-y)** singularity; the latter works for Coulomb interactions without diffusion but cannot prove strong propagation of chaos. Neither method alone can solve the quantitative analysis problem of 2D whole-space log gas systems. purple请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 在处理二维库仑气体系统时，相对熵方法和调制能量方法各自存在局限性。相对熵方法能有效利用扩散项产生负的相对Fisher信息项，但在计算中会遇到奇异项 div K(x-y) 的难题。另一方面，调制能量方法能很好地处理无扩散项的库仑情况，但仅凭此方法不足以证明强混沌传播。由于在二维库仑势中 div K = δ₀，因此单独使用这两种方法中的任何一种都无法解决问题。
source: Roughly speaking, the relative entropy method can make perfect use of the diffusion term with positive viscosity, as when computing the time derivative of the relative entropy, it produces an extra negative relative Fisher information term.

However, one may face some singular term div K(x-y) in the computations, which naturally vanishes in the 2D Navier-Stokes case, since in that case the kernel given by Biot-Savart law ... is divergence-free.

On the other hand, the modulated energy method can well treat the Coulomb case in any dimension but without diffusion term, since it is in its nature designed as a Coulomb/Riesz based metric in view of Fourier transform.
A pure modulated energy method is also not enough to show strong propagation of chaos.

In the Coulomb potential case we consider here, we have div K = Δg = δ₀, hence any single argument using only relative entropy H_N(ρ_N | ρ̄_N) or modulated energy F(μ_N, ρ̄) individually will not work.

qa_pairs.question: 特定场景的挑战 Challenges in Specific Scenarios 在**全空间而非环面**的二维对数气体系统中，粒子质量会随时间逃逸至无穷远，导致**平衡态测度缺乏正下界**。这使得传统环面情形下的**对数梯度估计**和**Hessian估计**失效，必须建立新的**抛物型最大值原理**来控制解的长时间行为，特别是证明解满足==高斯下界==和==对数增长估计==。 In 2D log gas systems on **whole space rather than torus**, particle mass escapes to infinity over time, resulting in **lack of positive lower bound for equilibrium measures**. This invalidates traditional **logarithmic gradient estimates** and **Hessian estimates** from torus cases, necessitating new **parabolic maximum principles** to control long-time behavior of solutions, especially proving they satisfy ==Gaussian lower bounds== and ==logarithmic growth estimates==. teal请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 在全空间（whole space）背景下，与环面（torus）相比，研究二维对数气体系统面临的关键挑战在于解（$\ ar{\\rho}$）不再具有正下界，且其质量会随时间逃逸至无穷远。这一特性导致在环面情况下有效的估计方法失效，例如，无法保证对数梯度（$\\nabla \\log \\bar{\\rho}$）的有界性。为解决此问题，论文通过引入一种抛物型最大值原理，建立了关键的对数增长估计（logarithmic growth estimates）和高斯下界（Gaussian lower bound），从而成功控制了系统在全空间上的长时间行为。
source: The key issue of failure of the modulated free energy on the wholes space is that $\bar{\rho}$ has no longer the positive lower bound, compared with the torus case, which is also the main difficulty for the extension to whole space for the relative entropy method.
Moreover, the mass of solutions of the limit equation (1.4) will escape to infinity as $t \rightarrow \infty$, which causes the new difficulty to prove the uniform-in-time propagation of chaos.
For our whole space case, we can never expect such a lower bound on $\bar{\rho}$ and hence never get $\nabla \log \bar{\rho} \in L^{\infty}$.

We resolve this problem by adapting the modulated free energy method in [BJW23] to the whole space setting and establishing the crucial logarithmic growth estimates for the mean-field Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) equation of single component via the parabolic maximum principle.
In this subsection, we apply the maximum principle above to provide the Gaussian lower bound for our limit equation (1.4).
Using this kind of maximum principle, we prove the logarithmic growth estimates for the solution of the limit equation (1.4) with $\beta>0$.

qa_pairs.question: 现有研究的空白 Gaps in Existing Research 尽管环面上二维库仑气体的定量混沌传播已被Bresch-Jabin-Wang(2019)解决，且Liu-Yang(2016)建立了全空间情形的定性结果，但**全空间二维对数气体的定量混沌传播**仍属空白。现有研究无法处理全空间特有的质量逃逸问题，且缺乏对**平均场PNP方程**解的精确对数增长控制，导致无法建立具有明确时间依赖性的相对熵估计。 Although quantitative propagation of chaos for 2D Coulomb gas on torus was solved by Bresch-Jabin-Wang(2019) and qualitative results for whole space were established by Liu-Yang(2016), **quantitative propagation of chaos for 2D log gas on whole space** remains an open problem. Existing studies cannot handle mass escape unique to whole space and lack precise logarithmic growth control of solutions to **mean-field PNP equations**, preventing establishment of relative entropy estimates with explicit time dependence. green请从文中找出所有相关的句子，特别是那些可以帮助理解与此相关的具体实现细节的句子。
qa_pairs.answer: 该研究首次推导了全空间中二维对数气体（2D Log gas）的定量混沌传播，填补了现有研究的空白。先前研究中，Bresch-Jabin-Wang (2019) 解决了环面上的定量问题，而Liu-Yang (2016) 仅建立了全空间情形的定性结果。本文将定性收敛结果提升为定量，并克服了将方法从环面推广到全空间时的关键难题：极限密度不再具有正下界，且解的质量会随时间逃逸至无穷。为解决此问题，论文通过将调制自由能方法应用于全空间，并利用抛物最大值原理为平均场泊松-能斯特-普朗克（PNP）方程建立了关键的对数增长估计。
source: We derive the quantitative propagation of chaos in the sense of relative entropy for the first time for the 2D Log gas or the weakly interacting particle systems with 2D Coulomb interactions on the whole space.

In our 2D Log or 2D Coulomb case, quantitative propagation of chaos for systems set on the torus $\mathbb{T}^{2}$ has been established by Bresch-Jabin-Wang [BJW19a], while qualitative propagation of chaos (without convergence rate) for 2 D Log gas on the whole space $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ has been established by Liu-Yang [LY16], following the entropy based compactness argument in [FHM14].

This result also improves the qualitative convergence from the particle system (1.1) towards the limit system (1.3) on $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ by the compactness argument in [LY16] to a quantitative counterpart.

The key issue of failure of the modulated free energy on the wholes space is that $\bar{\rho}$ has no longer the positive lower bound, compared with the torus case, which is also the main difficulty for the extension to whole space for the relative entropy method.
Moreover, the mass of solutions of the limit equation (1.4) will escape to infinity as $t \rightarrow \infty$, which causes the new difficulty to prove the uniform-in-time propagation of chaos.

We resolve this problem by adapting the modulated free energy method in [BJW23] to the whole space setting and establishing the crucial logarithmic growth estimates for the mean-field Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) equation of single component via the parabolic maximum principle.

qa_pairs.answer: 该研究成功地将调制自由能方法从环面（torus）设置扩展到全空间（whole space），以解决二维库仑相互作用下的粒子系统问题。此方法通过结合相对熵与调制能量，能够精确抵消在计算中出现的奇异项`div K(x-y)`，从而克服了单独使用相对熵或调制能量方法的局限性。扩展至全空间的主要挑战在于，与环面情况不同，极限密度`ρ̄`在全空间中不再具有正的下界。研究通过为平均场方程的解建立关键的对数增长估计（logarithmic growth estimates），并利用抛物最大值原理，最终解决了这一难题，首次为全空间中的二维对数气体（Log gas）导出了定量的混沌传播结果。
source: We resolve this problem by adapting the modulated free energy method in [BJW23] to the whole space setting and establishing the crucial logarithmic growth estimates for the mean-field Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) equation of single component via the parabolic maximum principle.

Hence in the series of work by Bresch-Jabin-Wang [BJW19b, BJW19a, BJW23], the above two quantites are combined with appropriate weights, which cancels exactly the singular term div K(x-y) in the computation of time derivative, but still preserves the coerciveness over the relative entropy.

Briefly speaking, our main contribution is to extend this modulated free energy method, which has been used in [BJW19a] for the 2D Coulomb gas on the torus case, to the 2 D whole space by obtaining the logarithimic growth estimates for the solution of the limit equation (1.4), which leads to the first quantitative convergence from the $N$-particle system (1.1) towards the limit McKean-Vlasov system (1.3) on $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ with any $\beta>0$.

The key issue of failure of the modulated free energy on the wholes space is that $\bar{\rho}$ has no longer the positive lower bound, compared with the torus case, which is also the main difficulty for the extension to whole space for the relative entropy method.

In the Coulomb potential case we consider here, we have $\operatorname{div} K=\Delta g=\delta_{0}$, hence any single argument using only relative entropy $\mathcal{H}_{N}(\rho_{N} | \bar{\rho}_{N})$ or modulated energy $F(\mu_{N}, \bar{\rho})$ individually will not work.

source: Using this kind of maximum principle, we prove the logarithmic growth estimates for the solution of the limit equation (1.4) with β > 0.

The basic idea is applying the Bernstein's method, say constructing some auxiliary functions containing some quantities to be estimated, then propagating the auxiliary functions along the parabolic operator and adapting the maximum principle.

For the long time logarithmic gradient estimate for ρ̄, we need to construct a new auxiliary function

$$ 
\tilde{F}(x, t)=\frac{t}{C+1} \frac{|\nabla \bar{\rho}|^{2}}{\bar{\rho}}+\bar{\rho} \log \bar{\rho}-C_{1} \bar{\rho}
$$

Substituting the lower bound of log ρ̄ in Proposition 3.1,

$$ 
\log \bar{\rho} \geq-C-C \log (1+t)-C \frac{|x|^{2}}{1+t}
$$

for some C>0. We finally obtain

$$ 
|\nabla \log \bar{\rho}|^{2} \leq \frac{C}{t}\left(1+\log (1+t)+\frac{|x|^{2}}{1+t}\right)
$$

Theorem 3.1 (Logarithmic Gradient Estimate). Assume that the initial data ρ̄₀ satisfies the following logarithmic growth conditions,

$$ 
\begin{gathered}
|\nabla \log \bar{\rho}_{0}(x)| \lesssim 1+|x| \\
|\nabla^{2} \log \bar{\rho}_{0}(x)| \lesssim 1+|x|^{2}
\end{gathered}
$$

and the Gaussian upper bound that there exists some C₀ > 0 such that

$$ 
\bar{\rho}_{0}(x) \leq C_{0} \exp \left(-C_{0}^{-1}|x|^{2}\right)
$$

Then we have the linear growth upper bound for the gradient of log ρ̄,

$$ 
|\nabla \log \bar{\rho}|^{2} \leq \frac{C}{1+t}\left(1+\log (1+t)+\frac{|x|^{2}}{1+t}\right)
$$

Theorem 3.2 (Logarithmic Hessian Estimate). Assume that the initial data ρ̄₀ satisfies the same conditions as in Theorem 3.1, then we have the quadratic growth upper bound for the Hessian of log ρ̄,

$$ 
\left|\nabla^{2} \log \bar{\rho}\right| \leq \frac{C}{1+t}\left(1+\log (1+t)+\frac{|x|^{2}}{1+t}\right)
$$
